Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to successfully retrieve the requested information from the Britannica source. In Step 2, the Planner instructed the agent to open the Britannica article to capture the exact name and details. However, the WebSurfer's response indicates that it only found search results on DuckDuckGo (showing Wikipedia and Society for Industrial Archeology links) and did not actually navigate to or extract content from the Britannica website. The agent reported seeing a Britannica link in the search results but did not provide the specific data (Title, URL, Publisher, exact name used) that was explicitly requested in the instructions. This failure to execute the specific action of retrieving the authoritative source led to a lack of the required second credible source, forcing the conversation into a repetitive loop of searching for the same information without success.
